MANDARIN — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #9
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MANDARIN
TIME ALLOWED: 120 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Fill the blank with the word that means "am called": 你好!我____小明。 (1 mark)
   A. 去
   B. 有
   C. 是
   D. 叫

2. Which sentence is a correct answer to 这是谁? (1 mark)
   A. 电视在哪儿?
   B. 这是我妈妈。
   C. 我在家。
   D. 这是什么?

3. What is special about Mandarin words for brothers and sisters? (1 mark)
   A. They have no tones
   B. They are only used by adults
   C. They are all the same word
   D. There are different words for older and younger ones

4. Read the pinyin: nà shì wǒ gēge. What does it mean? (1 mark)
   A. Who is this?
   B. This is my father.
   C. That is my older brother.
   D. There are five people in my family.

5. Why is it a good habit to keep household items in their proper places? (1 mark)
   A. It makes things harder to find
   B. It keeps the home tidy and safe
   C. It wastes time
   D. It makes the house noisy

6. Which Chinese word means "to sing"? (1 mark)
   A. 快乐 kuàilè
   B. 礼物 lǐwù
   C. 唱歌 chànggē
   D. 盘子 pánzi

7. Read the pinyin: wǒ de shēngrì shì sān yuè wǔ hào. What does it mean? (1 mark)
   A. We cut the cake.
   B. We sing.
   C. My birthday is on 5 March.
   D. When is your birthday?

8. Which Chinese word means "they"? (1 mark)
   A. 唱歌 chànggē
   B. 祝 zhù
   C. 他们 tāmen
   D. 送 sòng

9. Which Chinese word means "dinner"? (1 mark)
   A. 午饭 wǔfàn
   B. 牛肉 niúròu
   C. 晚饭 wǎnfàn
   D. 喜欢 xǐhuan

10. Read the pinyin: wǒ hē chá. What does it mean? (1 mark)
   A. I like to eat bananas.
   B. I drink tea.
   C. This is a banana.
   D. For breakfast I eat bǐng.

11. What does 牛肉 (niúròu) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Vegetables
   B. Flat bread
   C. Beef
   D. Water

12. "I am in the middle of your face and help you breathe." Which word is the answer? (1 mark)
   A. 嘴巴 zuǐba
   B. 鼻子 bízi
   C. 头 tóu
   D. 脚 jiǎo

13. Which Chinese word means "drought"? (1 mark)
   A. 干旱 gānhàn
   B. 天 tiān
   C. 刮风 guā fēng
   D. 小 xiǎo

14. Fill the blank: 沙发在门____。 (The sofa is beside the door.) (1 mark)
   A. 下面
   B. 里
   C. 上面
   D. 旁边

15. Which sentence means "Thank you!"? (1 mark)
   A. 我叫小明。
   B. 谢谢!
   C. 老师好!
   D. 你呢?

16. In the syllable jiào, what is the initial? (1 mark)
   A. j
   B. ia
   C. i
   D. o

17. What does 你好 (nǐ hǎo) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Hello
   B. I, me
   C. To be called
   D. Classmates

18. A picture shows a father, but the label says 妈妈. Is the pair right or wrong? (1 mark)
   A. Wrong, 对
   B. Wrong, 错
   C. Right, 错
   D. Right, 对

19. What does 房间 (fángjiān) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Left side
   B. Where
   C. Room
   D. Beside

20. Which sentence means "The television is on the table."? (1 mark)
   A. 客厅里有电视。
   B. 电视在客厅。
   C. 电视在桌子上。
   D. 椅子在桌子下。

21. Which Chinese word means "church"? (1 mark)
   A. 清真寺 qīngzhēnsì
   B. 去 qù
   C. 教堂 jiàotáng
   D. 昨天 zuótiān

22. What does 月 (yuè) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Candle
   B. To play
   C. Month
   D. To give (a gift)

23. Read the pinyin: zhù nǐ shēngrì kuàilè! What does it mean? (1 mark)
   A. My friend gives me a gift.
   B. My birthday is on 5 March.
   C. Happy birthday to you!
   D. When is your birthday?

24. What does 米饭 (mǐfàn) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Cooked rice
   B. Mango
   C. Fruit (as a group)
   D. Banana

25. What does 我用耳朵听 mean? (1 mark)
   A. I use my mouth to speak
   B. I use my eyes to see
   C. I use my ears to hear
   D. I use my hands to write

26. Which word is pronounced bízi? (1 mark)
   A. 肩膀
   B. 鼻子
   C. 牙
   D. 用

27. Fill the blank: 我用眼睛____。 (I use my eyes to see.) (1 mark)
   A. 听
   B. 说
   C. 喝
   D. 看

28. Read the pinyin: shāfā zài mén pángbiān. What does it mean? (1 mark)
   A. The bed is in the bedroom.
   B. The television is on the table.
   C. Where is the television?
   D. The sofa is beside the door.

29. Which sentence means "The bathroom is beside the garden."? (1 mark)
   A. 电视在哪儿?
   B. 窗户在沙发上面。
   C. 浴室在花园旁边。
   D. 门在左边。

30. What does 这 (zhè) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Older sister
   B. This
   C. Younger brother
   D. Is, am, are

31. How is 冰箱 written in pinyin? (1 mark)
   A. bìngxiàng
   B. bingxiang
   C. bīngxiāng
   D. bǐngxiāng

32. What does 上 (shàng) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Bedroom
   B. Room
   C. On
   D. Kitchen

33. What does 去 (qù) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Yesterday
   B. Church
   C. Mosque
   D. To go

34. Fill the blank: 我星期三____学校。 (On Wednesday I go to school.) (1 mark)
   A. 有
   B. 是
   C. 吃
   D. 去

35. How many strokes does 米 have? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 4
   C. 6
   D. 7

36. Read the pinyin: wǒ yòng zuǐba shuō. What does it mean? (1 mark)
   A. I use my mouth to speak.
   B. I have two eyes.
   C. I use my eyes to see.
   D. I use my ears to hear.

37. Which sentence means "Today it rains"? (1 mark)
   A. 雨下今天。
   B. 下今天雨。
   C. 今天下雨。
   D. 今天雨下。

38. What does 也 (yě) mean? (1 mark)
   A. It rains
   B. Also
   C. Small
   D. Cloud

39. What does 没有 (méiyǒu) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Sun
   B. Snow
   C. It rains
   D. There is not

40. Read the pinyin: mén zài zuǒbian. What does it mean? (1 mark)
   A. The sofa is beside the door.
   B. There is a bed in the bedroom.
   C. The door is on the left.
   D. The television is on the table.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
41. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "We sing." (2 marks)

42. Explain the sentence pattern for saying where something is, with an example. (3 marks)

43. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "My birthday is on 5 March." (3 marks)

44. Read and translate the chant line: 风来了,雨来了,雪也来了。 (3 marks)

45. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "Where is the sofa?" (2 marks)

46. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "I use my ears to hear." (2 marks)

47. Give three tips for following spoken instructions well. (3 marks)

48. Explain how to pause when reading: what does a comma mean and what does a full stop mean? (3 marks)

49. Explain the job of the apostrophe in the word nǚ'ér. (2 marks)

50. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "The door is on the left." (2 marks)

51. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "On Friday, go to the mosque." (3 marks)

52. Read the pinyin and write the English meaning: chuānghu zài shāfā shàngmiàn. (2 marks)

53. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "On Wednesday I go to school." (3 marks)

54. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 刷牙, 手 and 生日. (3 marks)

55. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "I use my mouth to speak." (2 marks)

56. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "My friend gives me a gift." (3 marks)

57. Read the pinyin and write the English meaning: wǒ xǐhuan hē chá. (2 marks)

58. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "What is this?" (2 marks)

59. Read the pinyin and write the English meaning: wǒmen qiē dàngāo. (2 marks)

60. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 花园 and 房子. (2 marks)

61. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "This is my older sister." (2 marks)

62. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "I love you." (2 marks)

63. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "There are five people in my family." (3 marks)

64. Explain one way rain helps the environment and one way too much rain harms it. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MANDARIN — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #9 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — 叫
   我叫 introduces a name.

2. B — 这是我妈妈。
   谁 asks who, and the answer names a person.

3. D — There are different words for older and younger ones
   Mandarin has gēge and dìdi, jiějie and mèimei.

4. C — That is my older brother.
   nà shì wǒ gēge. is 那是我哥哥。, which means "That is my older brother.".

5. B — It keeps the home tidy and safe
   Things in the right place are easy to find and do not cause accidents.

6. C — 唱歌 chànggē
   唱歌 (chànggē) means to sing.

7. C — My birthday is on 5 March.
   wǒ de shēngrì shì sān yuè wǔ hào. is 我的生日是三月五号。, which means "My birthday is on 5 March.".

8. C — 他们 tāmen
   他们 (tāmen) means they.

9. C — 晚饭 wǎnfàn
   晚饭 (wǎnfàn) means dinner.

10. B — I drink tea.
   wǒ hē chá. is 我喝茶。, which means "I drink tea.".

11. C — Beef
   牛肉 (niúròu) means beef.

12. B — 鼻子 bízi
   The nose is in the middle of the face.

13. A — 干旱 gānhàn
   干旱 (gānhàn) means drought.

14. D — 旁边
   旁边 is beside.

15. B — 谢谢!
   谢谢! (xièxie!) means "Thank you!".

16. A — j
   j is the initial. iao is the final.

17. A — Hello
   你好 (nǐ hǎo) means hello.

18. B — Wrong, 错
   妈妈 is mother, not father.

19. C — Room
   房间 (fángjiān) means room.

20. C — 电视在桌子上。
   电视在桌子上。 (diànshì zài zhuōzi shàng.) means "The television is on the table.".

21. C — 教堂 jiàotáng
   教堂 (jiàotáng) means church.

22. C — Month
   月 (yuè) means month.

23. C — Happy birthday to you!
   zhù nǐ shēngrì kuàilè! is 祝你生日快乐!, which means "Happy birthday to you!".

24. A — Cooked rice
   米饭 (mǐfàn) means cooked rice.

25. C — I use my ears to hear
   耳朵 is ears and 听 is hear.

26. B — 鼻子
   鼻子 is pronounced bízi and means nose.

27. D — 看
   看 is to see.

28. D — The sofa is beside the door.
   shāfā zài mén pángbiān. is 沙发在门旁边。, which means "The sofa is beside the door.".

29. C — 浴室在花园旁边。
   浴室在花园旁边。 (yùshì zài huāyuán pángbiān.) means "The bathroom is beside the garden.".

30. B — This
   这 (zhè) means this.

31. C — bīngxiāng
   Both syllables have the first tone.

32. C — On
   上 (shàng) means on.

33. D — To go
   去 (qù) means to go.

34. D — 去
   去 means to go.

35. C — 6
   米 has six strokes.

36. A — I use my mouth to speak.
   wǒ yòng zuǐba shuō. is 我用嘴巴说。, which means "I use my mouth to speak.".

37. C — 今天下雨。
   今天 + 下雨.

38. B — Also
   也 (yě) means also.

39. D — There is not
   没有 (méiyǒu) means there is not.

40. C — The door is on the left.
   mén zài zuǒbian. is 门在左边。, which means "The door is on the left.".

SECTION B
----
41. (2 marks)
   Answer: 我们唱歌。 wǒmen chànggē.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

42. (3 marks)
   Answer: Thing + 在 + place, with 上 or 下 at the end when needed. For example 电视在桌子上。
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the pattern, 1 mark for the example, 1 mark for the translation.

43. (3 marks)
   Answer: 我的生日是三月五号。 wǒ de shēngrì shì sān yuè wǔ hào.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters in the correct order, 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks, 1 mark for punctuation.

44. (3 marks)
   Answer: Fēng lái le, yǔ lái le, xuě yě lái le. The wind has come, the rain has come, the snow has come too.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for pinyin, 2 marks for meaning.

45. (2 marks)
   Answer: 沙发在哪儿? shāfā zài nǎr?
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

46. (2 marks)
   Answer: 我用耳朵听。 wǒ yòng ěrduo tīng.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

47. (3 marks)
   Answer: Listen to the whole instruction; catch the key words; ask for a repeat if unsure; show the answer by pointing or drawing.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each tip.

48. (3 marks)
   Answer: A comma is a short pause and a full stop is a longer pause, so you can breathe and the listener can follow.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for comma, 1 mark for full stop, 1 mark for the reason.

49. (2 marks)
   Answer: It shows where one syllable ends and the next begins, nǚ + ér.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each part of the explanation.

50. (2 marks)
   Answer: 门在左边。 mén zài zuǒbian.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

51. (3 marks)
   Answer: 星期五,去清真寺。 xīngqīwǔ, qù qīngzhēnsì.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters in the correct order, 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks, 1 mark for punctuation.

52. (2 marks)
   Answer: The window is above the sofa.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the general meaning and 1 mark for all the key words correct.

53. (3 marks)
   Answer: 我星期三去学校。 wǒ xīngqīsān qù xuéxiào.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters in the correct order, 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks, 1 mark for punctuation.

54. (3 marks)
   Answer: 刷牙: shuāyá, to brush teeth. 手: shǒu, hand. 生日: shēngrì, birthday.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

55. (2 marks)
   Answer: 我用嘴巴说。 wǒ yòng zuǐba shuō.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

56. (3 marks)
   Answer: 朋友送我礼物。 péngyou sòng wǒ lǐwù.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters in the correct order, 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks, 1 mark for punctuation.

57. (2 marks)
   Answer: I like to drink tea.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the general meaning and 1 mark for all the key words correct.

58. (2 marks)
   Answer: 这是什么? zhè shì shénme?
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

59. (2 marks)
   Answer: We cut the cake.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the general meaning and 1 mark for all the key words correct.

60. (2 marks)
   Answer: 花园: huāyuán, garden. 房子: fángzi, house.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

61. (2 marks)
   Answer: 这是我姐姐。 zhè shì wǒ jiějie.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

62. (2 marks)
   Answer: 我爱你。 wǒ ài nǐ.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

63. (3 marks)
   Answer: 我家有五口人。 wǒ jiā yǒu wǔ kǒu rén.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters in the correct order, 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks, 1 mark for punctuation.

64. (4 marks)
   Answer: Rain gives water to crops, rivers and animals. Too much rain can cause floods that damage crops and homes.
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for the benefit and 2 marks for the harm.
